decision: APPROVED PROSPECTIVE ONLY; historical PR919 AI-assisted outcomes unchanged
reconstruction: PR919 experimental candidate-only reconstruction; baseline unchanged
eligibility: affected when Python independently-validated port of HEAD Kotlin split() and splitCjkAware() produce different UTF-16 end offsets; fixed before output

scoring.scale: 0..5 in 0.5 increments (one blinded rubric scorer; source-visible; no strategy mapping)
scoring.materialRegression: new wrong negation, lost/added material information, speaker/POV/person reference error, characterization distortion, critical names/terminology or incomplete narrative; score difference alone does not substitute for a quoted error
scoring.criticalRegression: material error that reverses central plot, negation, speaker, or identity; automatic FAIL
scoring.disagreement: two independent masked AI scoring passes if first-pass confidence<0.75 or paired fluency/readability abs delta>=1, and all high-severity flags; keep both and adjudicate using source quotes before unblind; if irresolvable HOLD
scoring.blindness: review packets carry only source, X/Y translations and short sample ID; no mapping, offsets, timing, request metadata
scoring.scoreLock: write final blind scores, sha256 before opening mapping file; no retrospection after unblind

thresholds.breadthRule: delta fluency>=+0.5 OR readability>=+0.5 AND other reading metric>=0 AND fidelity>=0
thresholds.semanticSafety: no material or critical candidate regressions on all frozen samples

estimators.pairedDelta: candidate minus baseline for a given frozen sample ID
estimators.affectedMean: sum deltas over all predeclared affected samples / count of affected, no output-based sample selection
estimators.perLanguage: evaluate on frozen full (fidelity,weighted) and frozen affected (fluency,readability,weighted)
estimators.breadth: numerator predeclared affected samples meeting rule / denominator all predeclared affected samples
estimators.requestOverhead: median over all 18 frozen paired per-sample request counts candidate vs baseline; (median_candidate/median_baseline)-1
estimators.elapsedOverhead: median over all 18 frozen paired per-sample elapsed times candidate vs baseline; (median_candidate/median_baseline)-1
estimators.order: cryptographically randomized per sample after freeze; half baseline first / half candidate first per language (3+3)
estimators.repeats: one paired run per sample; repeat only failed/incomplete samples or targeted diagnostic justified by evidence, never choose best outputs
estimators.pacing: 750ms delay between requests each arm, same as prior live baseline; record actual raw provider output per segment, reconstructed output, error type, response timing

limitations: Original synthetic narrative fragments; generic recurring narrative beats reduce independent literary diversity. This gate is directional and not a substitute for real-EPUB and physical-device validation before rollout.
